text:
sarah: Quick FYI — opened a small infra PR that tweaks the inference-router Deployment: lowering static replicas from 6 -> 4 for eu-west low-traffic pool and adjusting startup/readiness probes. Also updates the Terraform secret path mapping (data-plane/secret -> data-plane/secrets). Can infra folks eyeball before I merge? https://git.company/repo/pull/4122

kevin: link works. Why drop replicas instead of changing autoscaler targets? ping @matt for capacity implications.

sarah: Autoscaler min/max stays the same (HPA min=1). This change is only to reduce reserved baseline cost during non-peak hours; we'll bump back up if canary traffic appears. The TF change moves the secret reference to the standardized path in secret manager. Small snippet from k8s portion:```
resource "kubernetes_deployment" "inference_router" {
  spec { replicas = 4 }
}
```

jordan: Did you check rolling behavior? If we drop replicas and do a rollingUpdate, we might reduce capacity temporarily — could affect tail latency for warm-up requests.

kevin: Also confirm readinessProbe periodSeconds bumped? If probes are too aggressive we'll kill pods unnecessarily. :thinking_face:

sarah: Yep — tuned the probes after staging runs. startupProbe set to tolerate longer cold-starts. Snippet from the manifest:```
readinessProbe:
  periodSeconds: 5
  initialDelaySeconds: 10
startupProbe:
  failureThreshold: 12
  periodSeconds: 10
```

matt: Don't switch to Recreate for this. Keep RollingUpdate and set maxSurge/maxUnavailable to safe values. Consider adding a PodDisruptionBudget so we don't drop below N pods during maintenance.

sarah: We're using RollingUpdate with `maxSurge: 1` and `maxUnavailable: 1`. I added a PDB in the same PR to keep minAvailable: 2 for eu-west. Staging passed smoke tests.

infra-bot: terraform plan finished — shows secret resource path rename and a change to the deployment replicas. Note: KMS policy unchanged but prod apply will require SRE manual approval due to IAM binding.

kevin: I looked at the TF diff — couple of nit variable names but nothing blocking. I will run a quick canary in the eu-west cluster tomorrow morning. Also recommend adding annotation `rollout.kubernetes.io/strategy: rolling` so it's explicit in Git history.

jordan: LGTM from my side, low risk after PDB and probe tweaks.

sarah: Thanks — I've addressed the variable nits and added the annotation.

matt: I'll hold merge until kevin confirms the canary, but happy to approve once infra-bot shows apply ready. :white_check_mark:

kevin: Will do the canary at 09:30 UTC tomorrow and post results here. If anyone sees anything unexpected between now and then, please flag.
